# csp-builder

> Typed Content-Security-Policy builder with fluent directive methods, nonce/hash helpers, and standards-compliant header generation.

Provides a strongly-typed builder for constructing Content-Security-Policy headers with method chaining. Includes directive setters (defaultSrc, scriptSrc, styleSrc, etc.), keyword constants ('self', 'none', with 'unsafe-inline' documented as discouraged), cryptographic nonce and hash generation, reportOnly mode, header serialization (toString), metadata variant (toMeta — drops frame-ancestors per spec), and round-trip parsing.

## API

```typescript
export const KEYWORDS: { self, none, unsafeInline, unsafeEval, strictDynamic, reportSample }

class CSPBuilder {
  constructor(options?: { reportOnly?: boolean })
  defaultSrc(...values: DirectiveValue[]): this
  scriptSrc(...values: DirectiveValue[]): this
  styleSrc(...values: DirectiveValue[]): this
  imgSrc(...values: DirectiveValue[]): this
  connectSrc(...values: DirectiveValue[]): this
  frameAncestors(...values: DirectiveValue[]): this
  nonce(value: string): string
  hash(content: string, algorithm?: "sha256" | "sha384" | "sha512"): string
  generateNonce(): string
  toString(): string
  toMeta(): string
  getHeaderName(): string
  static parse(headerValue: string): CSPBuilder
}
```

## Install

```bash
npm install csp-builder
```

## Use

```typescript
import CSPBuilder, { KEYWORDS } from "csp-builder";

const csp = new CSPBuilder()
  .defaultSrc(KEYWORDS.self)
  .scriptSrc(KEYWORDS.self, "https://trusted.com")
  .nonce(csp.generateNonce())
  .toString();
```

## Limits

- No validation of directive combinations (that's application logic)
- frame-ancestors dropped from toMeta() per spec (meta tag limitation)
- No runtime enforcement; purely header generation

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
